justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppender.java`, `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/FieldAttributeAppender.java`, and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/attribute/AnnotationAppenderTargetTest.java`. `OnField` is a small nested adapter with one `FieldVisitor` field and only two delegating methods (`visitAnnotation` and `visitTypeAnnotation`), so its outgoing dependency count is minimal. Its incoming use is also narrow: only two production call sites in `FieldAttributeAppender` and one dedicated test class reference it. This is not the high fan-in/high fan-out dependency hub required for hub-like modularization.
